verdicts.reason: A: the 'Sunset Sessions' headline stays dominant, but it is crammed against the left and bottom edges. The tagline floats above the date, out of reading order. The RSVP button is the same size as the pills and sits in the same grid, so the call to action is buried. 'Reserve a spot' is cut off from its button and sits in another column. The legal text is crammed against the missing-asset box, and the can is shrunk to a small top-right graphic. B: the four-column layout scatters the content. The RSVP button is a tiny pill in the top-right corner, and the legal text is as big as the body copy, which is wrong hierarchy. The tagline wraps narrowly and leaves 'year' alone on the last line. The headline is undersized, and the missing-asset box is clipped. B's can-in-circle is a nice touch, but A keeps the clearer headline-led hierarchy.
